prompts.question: Does this company appear in the Altares Dun & Bradstreet Nederland database with a verifiable DUNS number and corporate family record?
prompts.why_it_matters: A matching DUNS record confirms the company's legal identity and financial risk profile before any trade or credit decision.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the Altares.nl company search and enter the company's registered name.
prompts.found_when: A company record with the matching name, DUNS number or corporate family link is returned.
prompts.not_found_when: A search on the exact registered name returns no company record at all.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search endpoint fails or the name matches so many companies that the record cannot be identified.

prompts.question: Is this organisation listed in the Belastingdienst ANBI Register as holding public benefit (ANBI) status?
prompts.why_it_matters: A claim of ANBI status is only valid if the organisation appears in the tax authority's own register, which also exposes its published finances.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the Belastingdienst ANBI search and enter the full statutory name of the stichting or vereniging.
prompts.found_when: The organisation is returned with an ANBI designation and its published policy plan or remuneration data.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search on the exact statutory name returns no ANBI entry.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register search is unavailable or the organisation trades under a name different from its statutory name.

prompts.question: Is this company listed as a member of Bouwend Nederland?
prompts.why_it_matters: Membership shows the contractor is bound by the sector's safety rules and tender standards rather than operating outside them.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Bouwend Nederland organisation search on the members section and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the members result with its name and place of business.
prompts.not_found_when: The members search on the company name returns no matching organisation.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member search is down or the company name is too generic to match a single organisation.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in the BouwGarant register of certified builders and contractors?
prompts.why_it_matters: BouwGarant certification means the builder carries insolvency insurance and dispute coverage, which protects the client if the firm fails.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the BouwGarant builder search page and enter the company name or its certification number.
prompts.found_when: A certified builder record with the matching company name and valid certificate is shown.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no certified builder for that company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search page fails to load or the company name returns a long list of unrelated builders.

prompts.question: Is this company listed as a BOVAG member for its garage, dealership, rental or driving school activities?
prompts.why_it_matters: BOVAG membership backs the warranty and complaint mediation a customer gets, so an unlisted firm offers weaker consumer protection.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the BOVAG member search (leden) and enter the company name and place.
prompts.found_when: A BOVAG member page for the company exists with its branch and services listed.
prompts.not_found_when: The member search on the company name returns no BOVAG member entry.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member search is unavailable or several franchises share the same trading name.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in the De Nederlandsche Bank openbaar register with a licence for its financial activity?
prompts.why_it_matters: Only entities in the DNB register may lawfully offer banking, insurance, pension, payment or trust services in the Netherlands.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the DNB openbaar register and search the statutory name of the company.
prompts.found_when: The company appears with a register entry and the licence type it holds.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search on the statutory name returns no register entry.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register is offline or the group name returns several legal entities that cannot be told apart.

prompts.question: Does this company have a public profile or published assignments on Freelance.nl?
prompts.why_it_matters: A public profile shows how the company presents its services, rates and track record to Dutch clients.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Freelance.nl profile and project search and enter the company or trade name.
prompts.found_when: A profile page for the company is returned with its description, rates or listed projects.
prompts.not_found_when: The site search returns no profile or project linked to that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search is blocked or the name is so common that profiles of unrelated freelancers dominate.

prompts.question: Does this company appear on the Kansspelautoriteit site as a licensed gambling or lottery operator, or in its penalty and warning notices?
prompts.why_it_matters: The gambling authority's register and enforcement notices separate lawful operators from illegal ones and flag past sanctions.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the site search on kansspelautoriteit.nl and enter the company name, checking both register and enforcement results.
prompts.found_when: The company appears either in the licence register or in a published penalty, warning or cease-and-desist notice.
prompts.not_found_when: The site search returns no licence entry and no enforcement notice for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site search returns no usable results or the page structure cannot be read.

prompts.question: Does this company have a merchant page with customer reviews and a reliability score on Kieskeurig.nl?
prompts.why_it_matters: Review scores and dispute handling on Kieskeurig show how the merchant actually treats paying customers.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Kieskeurig.nl shops for the company name and open its store information page.
prompts.found_when: A shop page exists with reviews, a score or warranty and returns information.
prompts.not_found_when: No shop page is found for that company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The shop page exists but carries no reviews, or the site search is unavailable.

prompts.question: Is this company listed in the Kifid register of financial service providers with published complaints or rulings?
prompts.why_it_matters: Kifid rulings show whether customers have taken the firm to the financial ombudsman and how those disputes ended.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the Kifid financial service provider search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: The provider is listed and its published rulings or complaint records are shown.
prompts.not_found_when: The provider search returns no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The provider search fails or the name matches several group entities that cannot be distinguished.

prompts.question: Does this company have a complaint page with reported grievances and a response record on Klacht.nl?
prompts.why_it_matters: An open complaint file shows unresolved consumer disputes and how quickly the company responds to them.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Klacht.nl search and enter the company or brand name.
prompts.found_when: A company page is returned listing complaints, a satisfaction score or replies from the company.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no company page and no complaints for that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site blocks the search or the brand name also covers unrelated businesses.

prompts.question: Is this company registered in the Landelijk Register Kinderopvang as an approved childcare provider?
prompts.why_it_matters: Only registered providers may legally offer childcare, and the register also exposes inspection findings and operator identity.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the LRK search and enter the name of the childcare organisation or its holder.
prompts.found_when: A registered location or holder is returned with approval status and inspection details.
prompts.not_found_when: The register returns no location or holder for that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register search is unavailable or the childcare name is duplicated across municipalities.

prompts.question: Does this company run a commercial seller account on Marktplaats with visible ratings or reviews?
prompts.why_it_matters: Seller ratings and transaction history show whether the company actually trades at the volume and quality it advertises.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Marktplaats for the company name and open the seller profile behind the listings.
prompts.found_when: A seller profile is found with the company name, listings and ratings or reviews.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no listings or seller profile linked to that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The seller name is not displayed publicly or the search cannot be completed.

prompts.question: Is this company listed as a member of NLdigital?
prompts.why_it_matters: NLdigital membership means the IT supplier endorses the sector's terms and standards, which is often claimed but not always true.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the NLdigital member pages for the company name and open its member page.
prompts.found_when: A member page for the company exists with its description and membership details.
prompts.not_found_when: No member page is found for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member overview is unreachable or the name matches several group entities.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in the Stichting Normering Arbeid register as NEN 4400 certified?
prompts.why_it_matters: SNA certification proves payroll tax and VAT are paid, which shields clients from liability for the contractor's unpaid taxes.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the SNA certified companies list and search the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company is listed with a valid NEN 4400 certificate number and expiry date.
prompts.not_found_when: The certified companies list returns no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register search fails or the company name is too generic to identify the certified entity.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in NVWA inspection results, approvals or recall notices?
prompts.why_it_matters: NVWA findings reveal hygiene failures, safety violations or recalls that the company does not advertise itself.

source.name: Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA Inspection Results)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the NVWA site and the published company overview for the company name or its approval number.
prompts.found_when: The company appears with an approval, an inspection outcome or a published recall or warning.
prompts.not_found_when: No approval, inspection result or recall notice matches the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The inspection data is not published per company or the overview cannot be searched.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in Officiële Bekendmakingen (Staatscourant) in notices such as filings, permits, mergers, liquidations or sanctions?
prompts.why_it_matters: Official gazette notices record legal events the company may not publicise, including insolvency, permit decisions and sanctions.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the Officiële Bekendmakingen results page for the company name in quotation marks.
prompts.found_when: One or more notices naming the company are returned with a publication date and notice type.
prompts.not_found_when: A quoted search on the company name returns no notices.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search returns hits for unrelated names or the results page cannot be read.

prompts.question: Does this company appear in the Stichting Reclame Code archive of advertising complaints or rulings?
prompts.why_it_matters: Published SRC rulings show whether the company's marketing claims were found misleading, for example on sustainability.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the SRC ruling search and enter the company or brand name as keyword.
prompts.found_when: One or more rulings naming the company or its brand are returned.
prompts.not_found_when: The ruling search returns no decisions for that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search returns only rulings about other advertisers using the same word, or the archive is unreadable.

prompts.question: Is this company listed in the Raad voor Accreditatie register as an accredited laboratory, inspection or certification body?
prompts.why_it_matters: Only RvA-accredited bodies may issue recognised test reports and certificates, so the listing validates the scope claimed.

source.name: Raad voor Accreditatie (RvA - Dutch Accreditation Council)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the RvA organisation register for the company name and open its accreditation page.
prompts.found_when: An organisation page is returned listing the accreditation scope and register number.
prompts.not_found_when: The organisation register returns no accredited entity for that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register search fails or the name matches several accredited group entities.

prompts.question: Does this company appear as a patent holder or applicant in the Octrooicentrum Nederland register?
prompts.why_it_matters: A patent record shows the company's actual innovation output and legal status of its technology claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the Mijn Octrooi register search and enter the company name as holder or applicant.
prompts.found_when: Patent applications or granted patents are returned with the company as holder or applicant.
prompts.not_found_when: The register returns no patents for that holder name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register search is unavailable or the company files under a different legal entity name.

prompts.question: Is this company listed as a member in the Techniek Nederland member directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: Membership confirms the installer is recognised by the sector and bound by its technical and warranty standards.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Techniek Nederland ledenzoek member search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: A member result for the company is returned with its branch and location.
prompts.not_found_when: The member search returns no entry for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member search is unavailable or the name matches many small installation firms.

prompts.question: Does this company hold a valid Thuiswinkel Waarborg certification in the Thuiswinkel.org member list?
prompts.why_it_matters: The trust mark can only be used by certified web shops that meet Dutch rules on returns, payment and privacy.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the Thuiswinkel.org member list for the company name or web shop domain.
prompts.found_when: A member entry with the company name and a valid Thuiswinkel Waarborg certification is shown.
prompts.not_found_when: The member list returns no entry for the company or its web shop.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member search fails or the shop trades under a brand name not shown in the list.

prompts.question: Is this company listed as a member of VNO-NCW?
prompts.why_it_matters: Membership shows the company is inside the main employers' confederation and its policy and network position.
prompts.how_to_query: Scan the VNO-NCW members page for the company name or its branch association.
prompts.found_when: The company or its branch organisation is named in the member overview.
prompts.not_found_when: The members page does not name the company or any association it belongs to.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member list is not published in full or the page cannot be loaded.
